timing: Secondary analysis specified following the user's explicit local-jurisdiction correction, after MP35 outcomes and MP36 calibration are known, while the MP36 test campaign is executing. No MP36 final test outcome table has been inspected to select this analysis. Not original primary preregistration.
objective: Retain local evidence through the read/observed-segment, locus, and predefined-region scales. Global summaries are descriptive and cannot confer local authority.
data: All 64 planned test loci and every retained read-site record, both nested 150/300 nt windows. Preserve primary protocol, source hashes, fixed labels, exclusions, minimum 10 records and all unresolved or adverse cases.
local_units: Each locus with its exact REF/ALT/event and observed windows; per-read contrasts between alleles; paired edges between the frozen baseline and aggregate rules and between 150/300 nt. A locus is not a replicate of a molecule; a shared read across loci creates dependence.
read_diagnostics: Raw score preference, tie, expected-minus-alternative score margin, absolute admission under frozen 59/118 thresholds, relative accepted sets at 0 and 4. These are benchmark-relative diagnostics, not validated per-molecule truth calls. Retain contrary read preferences even when locus-level median agrees with benchmark.
strata: Fixed event sizes 2-4,5-10,11-30 nt; insertion/deletion; expected genotype 0/1; frozen 1Mb region; read orientation. Marginal strata and size-by-genotype cross strata. No outcome-adaptive bins, ranking or cutoff optimization.
local_decisions: Report paired correct/discordant/unresolved transitions and exact support at every locus. A change from unresolved to correct is local resolution gain; correct to unresolved is loss; any newly discordant call is adverse. Do not collapse discordance and abstention into a single score or infer population significance from per-locus counts.
topology: Descriptive graph: genomic-neighbor edges only within the same frozen region and shared-retained-read edges for observed dependence. Edge types remain distinct. These graphs do not by themselves establish mechanistic or causal biological interactions.
inference_boundary: Descriptive secondary audit on one benchmark individual/library. No local conditional coverage guarantee, independent replication, multiplicity-adjusted discovery or superiority claim is created by stratification. Any later outcome-guided jurisdiction refinement requires held-out evaluation. Gaussian summaries may remain useful within their verified jurisdiction; this is a granular extension, not a rejection of Gaussian methods.
